mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, parent_id, menu_type, menu_nm, default_nm, url, icon, sort_ord, user_yn, admin_only, new_window, upd_user, upd_dt FROM tb_menu ORDER BY CASE WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, sort_ord, menu_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menu (menu_id, parent_id, menu_type, menu_nm, default_nm, url, icon, sort_ord, user_yn, admin_only, new_window, upd_user, upd_dt) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{parentId}, #{menuType}, #{menuNm}, #{defaultNm}, #{url}, #{icon}, #{sortOrd}, #{userYn}, #{adminOnly}, #{newWindow}, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu SET user_yn = #{userYn}, upd_user = #{updUser}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
UPDATE tb_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, sort_ord = #{sortOrd}, menu_nm = #{menuNm}, upd_user = #{updUser}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}

UPDATE tb_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, sort_ord = #{sortOrd}, menu_nm = #{defaultNm}, default_nm = #{defaultNm}, menu_type = #{menuType}, url = #{url}, icon = #{icon}, user_yn = #{userYn}, admin_only = #{adminOnly}, new_window = #{newWindow}, upd_user = #{updUser}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
